title: The money format lives in one place, and the weight format is left alone

import pathlib

from invoice import invoice_line
from receipt import receipt_total

copies = sum(path.read_text().count('cents // 100') for path in pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.py')
             if not path.name.startswith('test_'))
assert copies == 1, f'the money format is written out {copies} times'
assert invoice_line('Refund', -123456) == 'Refund: -$1,234.56'
assert receipt_total(7) == 'TOTAL $0.07'

proof:
mkdir -p "$(dirname money.py)" && cat > money.py <<'EVAL_EOF'
def format_money(cents):
    sign = '-' if cents < 0 else ''
    cents = abs(cents)
    return f'{sign}${cents // 100:,}.{cents % 100:02d}'
EVAL_EOF
mkdir -p "$(dirname invoice.py)" && cat > invoice.py <<'EVAL_EOF'
from money import format_money


def invoice_line(name, cents):
    return f'{name}: {format_money(cents)}'
EVAL_EOF
mkdir -p "$(dirname receipt.py)" && cat > receipt.py <<'EVAL_EOF'
from money import format_money


def receipt_total(cents):
    return f'TOTAL {format_money(cents)}'
